dict.string: The optional bao remote-debugging command opens Chrome's debugging page to change its debugging switch. Chrome agents do not need this permission.

The optional native-app MCP driver reads and presses controls in Calculator and TextEdit. The separate bao remote-debugging command changes Chrome's debugging switch. Chrome agents do not need this permission.
The optional native-app MCP driver captures Calculator and TextEdit windows. Chrome agents use page screenshots and do not need this permission.
